name: Headspace Reverie
summary:
Explore the end of the World through a decaying virtual space.

Do you feel like something isn't quite right with the World? Do you feel a crippling sense of unease weighting you down a little bit more every day? Do you wanna scream for no particular reason? Do you look around and feel like everyone is doing okay except you? Are you a prisoner in your own head, with everything piling up with no way to prevent this?

This is the future, and it is terrifying.
